statements.statement: CPT 93229 mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring was ordered
Patient presenting with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness
Personal history of transient ischemic attacks and cerebral infarction (Z86.73, G45.9)
Extended ambulatory monitoring is necessary to correlate symptomatic events with potential arrhythmic activity
Extended ambulatory monitoring is necessary to guide anticoagulation and rate control strategies
The clinical indication note in the submitted records supports the medical necessity of this diagnostic study
Denial is based on required precertification or authorization not being obtained prior to service date
